upstream_requirements: Exports must come from already loaded module records; never require missing modules.
Reject any selected module record whose own __forceReload data field is true; accessor module metadata is not safe to evaluate.
Confirm selected loaded script sources match the hashes above before treating fields as current-build evidence. The reader does not attest loaded-source hashes.

Use ordinary JS cache objects, not Proxies or host interceptors, and trusted ECMAScript intrinsics. Descriptor operations themselves can execute Proxy traps; portable JS cannot establish this precondition.

field_semantics.local_player: CreatureModel.GetPlayerId -> ModelManager.PlayerInfoModel.GetId -> own xe; never CreatureModel._Mr (world owner).
field_semantics.roster: SceneTeamModel.aPr; SceneTeamItem.jpo(local flag),j8(player),Opo(group),Mne(role config),Wpo(CreatureDataId),Kpo(cached EntityHandle),zZa(auto role).
field_semantics.current: SceneTeamModel.YBi must be the identical local item, and its paired SceneTeamRole must be SceneTeamGroup.kpo.
field_semantics.creature_cache: CreatureModel.GetEntity -> hPr.EntityMap.Get; CustomMap.mvr(creature key to array index), K7(index to handle), dvr(index to creature key). EntityContainer.EntityIdMap maps runtime EntityId to CreatureDataId.
field_semantics.handle_valid: EntityHandle.Valid -> CharacterModel.IsValid(Id) -> nK[Id >>> ObjectSystem.VersionDigit]?.Id === Id. Reader additionally requires exact registered handle identity.
field_semantics.entity_valid: ObjectBase.Id and Index are own constructor fields. EntitySystem.Get and ObjectSystem.IsValid consult ObjectSystem.Objects[index] and Id. Reader also matches ObjectSystem.rY[index] to low generation bits.
field_semantics.entity_init: EntityHandle.IsInit = Valid && Entity.IsInit; Entity.IsInit is bool(pW & 8). Reader additionally rejects End(32)/Clear(64), PendingRemoving, and selected entries in pending/removal containers.
field_semantics.transition: Require IsTeamReady=true, BKl=0, Kq1=false; Vpo and LoadTeamPromise undefined; seamless flags/timestamp/timer/delayed handle idle; CreatureModel.CMr and LeavingLevel false. ChangingRole getter can mutate BKl on timeout and is never called.

id_policy: Accept only positive safe Number IDs, preserving the original Map key. BigInt, numeric strings, coercible objects and unsafe Numbers are explicitly rejected, never converted. Wpo and EntityHandle.Id are separate domains.
stage_member_count: expectedMemberCount defaults to the requested three-person stage and is configurable. Exported SCENE_TEAM_MAX_NUM is 4; the reader does not claim a game-wide three-member limit.
output_boundary: ready=true means cached roster/group/entity registrations agreed and the consumed observations were repeated. It never authorizes native binding, writes, rendering claims, or an atomic snapshot.
